messages:
Maria (CS): quick thread — batch of onboarding feedback from Aurelia Health pilot. top asks summarized below and in attached csv. main ask: per-route embeddings billing toggle (legal/billing blocker). also a bunch of 429 UX/SDK confusion and some latency complaints for long-context sends.
Ravi (PM): can you paste the top 3 pain + short impact/urgency so we can triage? cc @Jesse
Maria (CS): sure — top3: 1) per-route embeddings toggle — impact: HIGH, blocks alpha go-live, urgency: immediate. 2) 429 error messaging in SDK — impact: MED, spawns support tickets + confused customers. 3) embedding latency spikes on long docs — impact: LOW-MED, affects pilot UX but has a workaround (chunking).
Jesse (Product Ops): thanks. propose prioritization: P0 = per-route toggle (route-level flag exposed in console + API), P1 = 429 messaging (docs + SDK string + sample retry guidance), P2 = latency profiling and recommended chunking patterns. @Lena can you take SDK + docs text?
Lena (DevEx): I can. will draft improved error text and retry examples, and a small snippet for `client.on('error', ...)` behavior. timeline ~48 hours.
Tom (Support): fyi we have 6 open tickets from Aurelia referencing the 429 text — can push logs. also one ticket includes a repro payload if you need it.
feedback-bot: uploaded file `aurelia_onboard_feedback_1764527890.csv` (6 rows)
Ravi (PM): good. I'll mark per-route toggle as sprint P0 and pick a PM owner. Maria, can you attach any customer-facing language they're using around billing? also flag renewal health — pilot renewal check in ~4 weeks, risk bumped to moderate until billing clarity delivered. :warning:
Maria (CS): copying their billing note: "we need a per-route toggle so we can control cost on embeddings per environment" — will forward their exact quotes + a few example prompts that reproduce embed sizes by EOD. tagging renewal@cs for follow-up.
Jesse (Product Ops): I'll create the backlog item with the CSV + CS notes and link support tickets. adding acceptance criteria: (a) admin can toggle embeddings per route, (b) console shows per-route billing estimate, (c) SDK surfaces clearer 429 text and suggested retry window.
Lena (DevEx): drafting docs PR now; will include code example and a short migration note.
Tom (Support): attaching the six tickets to the backlog item once it's created.
Maria (CS): thanks all — goal: unblock Aurelia alpha and reduce renewal risk. will update here when I send prompts. :thumbsup:
